standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: It's strange, this place. From the plants, to the creatures... even the land itself. It's all undeniably horrifying, and yet... there's a certain feeling of peace here.
I wonder if it's the simplicity. There are no politics here. No debates. You don't need to care about good or evil, because there isn't any. Here you can just... be.
Or of course, maybe that's just the monster within me talking.
Are you sure? How do you know I'm not about to try and eat you right now?
Probably... Or am I? Hard to say for sure... You never know when the urge to feed will take hold...
Come on, [player name], look at me. Even other vampyres consider me an abomination... At least let me find some humour in all of this.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: hmph* Like you'd be able to eat me anyway. You do remember that I'm the one that finally killed Drakan, right?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: In truth, I can still barely believe it. All those years fighting him, and now it's finally all over... It almost doesn't feel real.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Well, you were a bit out of it for a fair chunk.
Oh, so the humour is only okay when you do it?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: Just seems a bit unfair to kick me while I'm down... Maybe I should eat you...

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: It's good to see you haven't changed, Safalaan.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: And for as long as I have friends like you, [player name], I hope I never will. Thank you... truly.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Like I told you, Safalaan, we're in this together. Anyway, I'll leave you to it, but we'll talk more soon.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-times.npc: [player name]. I must admit, things are very tiring at the moment. Even with help from mother, controlling this... condition takes a lot of work.
That's before we even get onto the work I've been doing to help Sugadinti with the blood shortages.
As a wyrd, I hunger far more than a normal vampyre. It... disgusts me, to be honest. However, it does mean I am a perfect test subject for Sugadinti.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-times.player: You're not doing too much, are you?

standard-dialogue-subsequent-times.npc: Perhaps, but I'd prefer to be useful. I find it easier, keeping myself busy. It helps me deal with things. Helps me come to terms with who I am now.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-times.player: Fair enough. You just make sure to let me know if anything gets too much.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-times.npc: Oh I will. As you yourself reminded me, it would be unwise to get on the bad side of the one who finally killed Drakan.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-times.player: Shame I didn't do the same to his sister. If I had, you'd never have been in this position.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-times.npc: Perhaps, or perhaps we'd just all be dead instead. Besides, Vanescula has already been well and truly punished for what she did.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-times.player: Not too eager to forgive her, are you?

standard-dialogue-subsequent-times.npc: Forgive her? Never. But with her in her state and me in mine, she'll fear me for the rest of her days.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-times.player: I suppose there is some justice in that.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-times.npc: Indeed. Now, you'll have to forgive me, [player name], but I believe Sugadinti will have need of me soon. I'll see you later.
